The conformality of thin films grown by ALD is investigated using all-silicon test structures with long, narrow lateral channels and a diffusion model.
The developed diffusion model incorporates low-pressure gas transport, dynamic Langmuir adsorption, and feature narrowing effects.
An analytical approximate solution allows fitting to measured thickness profiles to extract the adsorption equilibrium constant and sticking coefficient.
definition_note: Analytic approximate solution for parameter extraction.
